provenance: Samples exported by the project’s Pydantic-validated dataset adapters from local upstream downloads.

datasets.title: Strawberry transport · United States
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 declared by the upstream dataset card
datasets.what: Nine pallet-position temperature readings across six shipments; the release also includes a rule-derived future temperature-risk target.
datasets.use: Already explored above in this Field data view; the separate Evaluation Lab compares a classifier with a temperature rule.
datasets.limit: The future target is a weak temperature-state label, not measured spoilage, food quality, safety, or RSL.

sample.label: Open the observed strawberry shipment traces above.

datasets.title: Apple commercial cold storage · Germany
datasets.citation: Jedermann et al., Air, surface and dew point temperature under high humidity conditions during commercial cold storage of apples
datasets.what: High-volume cold-room air and apple-surface temperatures, with relative humidity and logger/test context.
datasets.use: Compare measured air and surface temperature histories and explore storage sensor variation.
datasets.limit: The dataset has no direct measured spoilage, sensory rejection, or remaining-shelf-life endpoint. This bounded trace is sampled from one test and one logger pair.

sample.label: Cold-room test T5 · one paired logger
sample.timeBasis: UTC timestamps. The displayed points are a deterministic sample of the measured trace; values retain the observed low and high in each series.

datasets.title: Bulk milk tank · Spain
datasets.citation: Cantarero Navarro et al., Dataset on Bulk Milk Tank Performance
datasets.what: Tank-surface and near-surface temperatures plus separately collected laboratory composition and bacteriology measurements.
datasets.use: Inspect a measured tank-day trace and see the kinds of lab measurements the source contains.
datasets.limit: This is raw farm-tank milk, not pasteurized retail milk or a shipment route. Lab samples are not joined to the displayed sensor trace, and these measurements are not a food-safety clearance.

sample.label: Most densely recorded tank day · 2024-10-14 UTC
sample.timeBasis: Source epoch timestamps converted to UTC.

datasets.title: Mango air cargo · Thailand to France
datasets.citation: Paviet-Salomon et al., Dataset of Air Cargo Supply Chain and Fruit Quality
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 · noncommercial use under the repository terms
datasets.what: Mango product temperature, surrounding-air temperature, humidity, shipment stage, and selected physical/chemical fruit measurements.
datasets.use: Explore how measured temperature changes across one logged route stage; measured quality values are shown separately.
datasets.limit: One shipment. Logger timestamps are local to their route stage and the timezone changes by stage. This sample plots only one stage. The measurements have not calibrated the app’s RSL model.

sample.label: Most densely recorded route stage · 1 Cold Storage
sample.timeBasis: Original local timestamps, kept within this one route stage; not converted across stages.

datasets.title: Retail produce display cases
datasets.citation: Monge et al., Temperature profiling of open- and closed-doored produce cases in retail grocery stores
datasets.what: 224 case-position summaries with average/minimum/maximum temperature, moisture, and source-reported high-temperature summaries.
datasets.use: Compare retail display conditions by case and position; useful for context, not time-series modeling.
datasets.limit: Rows have no timestamps and do not identify the produce in each case. Source-reported abuse statistics are not universal safety limits or spoilage labels.

sample.label: 12 case-position summaries with the highest reported mean temperature
sample.timeBasis: Not a time series: the source does not provide timestamps.

notice: Measured source data shown as examples; these samples do not train the dashboard RSL model, establish food safety, or prove operational accuracy.
